questions.markdown:
Determine the step response of the LTI system whose impulse response is

$$
h(t)=u(t-1)-2u(t-2)+u(t-3)
$$

Justify whether the following system is linear, time invariant, causal and memoryless:

$$
y[n]+2y[n-1]=x[n+1].
$$

questions.markdown: Let $x_1[n]=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{-n}u[-n]$ and $x_2[n]=\left(\frac{1}{\pi n}\right)\sin\left(\frac{\pi n}{3}\right)$. Use convolution property of Fourier representation to determine $x_1[n] * x_2[n]$

Apply necessary properties to determine the time domain representation of the following frequency domain representation.

$$
X(e^{j\Omega})=\left(\frac{1}{1-\frac{1}{3}e^{-j\Omega}}\right)\left(\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{2}e^{-j\Omega}}\right).
$$
Given $x(t)=\cos(\pi t)+2\sin(4\pi t)$. Determine the Fourier representation of $x(t)$ and plot the magnitude and phase spectrum.

Use DTFT to evaluate the response of the discrete time system having impulse response

$$
h[n]=\frac{\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}n\right)}{\pi n}
$$

to the input

$$
x[n]=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{8}n\right)+\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}n\right)
$$

Determine the frequency response and the impulse response of the LTI system which produces output $y(t)$ for the input $x(t)$ as described below:

$$
x(t)=e^{-t}u(t), \qquad y(t)=e^{-2t}u(t)+e^{-3t}u(t)
$$

Continuous time signal $x(t)$ with spectrum as shown in the following diagram is sampled with sampling time $T_s=0.5\,\text{sec}$. Zero order hold system is used for the reconstruction. Plot the magnitude spectrum of the reconstructed signal and compare with original spectrum.

diagrams.caption: Triangular spectrum $X(j\omega)$ centered at $\omega=0$, peak value 1 at 0, and zeros at $\omega=-\pi$ and $\omega=\pi$ (original source region)

questions.markdown:
Determine the inverse Z-Transform of

$$
H(Z)=\frac{1}{1-2.5z^{-1}+z^{-2}}
$$

for ROC:

(i) $|Z|>2$  
(ii) $|Z|<0.5$  
(iii) $0.5<|Z|<2$.

For the above specified cases, identify whether the system is causal, stable or both causal and stable.

Determine Z-Transform of the signal and indicate the ROC.

$$
x[n]=(0.2)^n[u[n]-u[n-1]] * n(0.8)^n u[n]
$$

For the following system with zero initial conditions described by differential equation, determine the impulse response assuming that the system is (i) stable (ii) causal

$$
\frac{d^2}{dt^2}y(t)+5\frac{d}{dt}y(t)+6y(t)=\frac{d^2}{dt^2}x(t)+8\frac{d}{dt}x(t)+13x(t)
$$
